name: 3M Littmann Classic III Stethoscope, Navy Blue
seoTitle: Littmann Classic III Navy Stethoscope Gift
metaDescription: The Littmann Classic III stethoscope with a navy blue tube and stainless chestpiece. A classic, everyday gift for nursing students and working nurses.
summary: A Littmann Classic III in navy blue, a dependable everyday stethoscope and one of the most popular gifts for nurses at any stage.
whyItWorks: Ask a group of nurses which stethoscope they carried through school or their first job, and the Classic III comes up again and again. It is a familiar, trusted name, so it is a gift that feels safe in the best way. Navy blue is about as classic as colors get. It matches navy scrubs, which many hospitals use as a uniform color, and it looks professional on day one of orientation.

For a parent or partner shopping for a nursing student, the Classic III is a natural graduation or pinning ceremony gift. It is also a good replacement for a nurse whose old stethoscope has finally given out after years of 12 hour shifts. The title lists a stainless steel chestpiece and a 27 inch tube, though the listing shows the length with a foot mark, so it is worth confirming. Pair it with a personalized ID tag and a card from you, and it becomes the stethoscope they remember receiving when they became a nurse.
goodToKnow: Confirm the tube length on the listing, since the title's measurement is formatted oddly.
Check whether their hospital requires a specific scrubs color, since navy will match most navy uniforms.
Ask quietly if they already own a Classic III so you do not duplicate it.

faq.q: Is the Classic III good for nursing students?
faq.a: Yes. It is one of the most common choices for students and new grads, which makes it a reliable graduation gift.

faq.q: Is navy a good color choice?
faq.a: Navy is a safe, professional pick that pairs with many hospital uniform colors and never looks out of place.
